name: writing
description:
Draft in the user's voice, and write errors they will see.

Voice stays off until you turn it on in the project.

- writing-voice: When you draft or revise documents, guides, emails, chat, tickets, or commit messages on the user's behalf, write the way this person writes.
- writing-error-messages: When you write or revise an error the user will see, say what happened, why, and what they should do next.
